title: Login Admin
remediation: Use parameterized queries and validate credentials server-side

title: User Credentials
payload_used: UNION-based SQL injection (exact payload not retained)
impact: Retrieved user emails and password hashes
remediation: Use parameterized queries and restrict response fields

title: Reflected XSS via Search
impact: Script runs in the victim's browser when they click a crafted search link; could steal session cookies or redirect the user
remediation: Sanitize and encode user input before reflecting it back into the page; use a strict Content Security Policy

title: Stored XSS via Customer Feedback
payload_used: <script>alert('xss')</script> (sent directly via API to bypass client-side filtering)
impact: Payload persists in the database and executes automatically in an administrator's browser when they view the Customer Feedback list
remediation: Sanitize/encode all user input server-side before storing and before rendering it back to any user including admins
